adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 312-314 in the diff for deleteEvent: `const calendarId = externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;`. When externalCalendarId is falsy (the else branch), the code tries to find a calendar where `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId`, but externalCalendarId is already falsy at this point, so this will never match anything and return undefined. This means calendarId will be undefined and fall back to defaultCalendarId ('primary'), potentially deleting from the wrong calendar. This is the same logical bug pattern as in updateEvent at line 253.
